environment: Local Next.js production server at localhost:3100, Lighthouse 13.5.0, Chrome 155. Mobile simulated slow 4G and 4x CPU slowdown; desktop official Lighthouse desktop configuration. Lab data, not deployed field Core Web Vitals.
notes: The first 45-page mobile sweep had one performance failure: homepage 88. The other 44 routes scored 93–99. Three subsequent isolated homepage runs scored 90, 96 and 93. All original and repeated measurements are retained.

SEO is intentionally excluded from noindex private-entry screens. Authenticated dashboard, account history, signed order receipts, OTP/email delivery, payment processing and live order creation were not Lighthouse-audited.
Final browser verification passed after the last city-search change. No production deployment or Search Console account action was performed.
